headline: New rules for TCB: Who can get subsidized food cards
summary: The government has issued new guidelines for selecting TCB beneficiaries, prioritizing low-income groups, widows, and families with disabled persons.
details: The Ministry of Commerce has issued the 'Implementation Guidelines-2026' for the selection of Trading Corporation of Bangladesh (TCB) beneficiaries across the country.
